summary.text: Kelly K. Convirs-Fowler is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 96th District, which covers part of the city of Virginia Beach, and has served since 2018.
Convirs-Fowler sits on the House committees on Privileges and Elections, Labor and Commerce and Education.

paragraphs.text: Kelly K. Convirs-Fowler was born in Groton, CT, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Convirs-Fowler's education as Virginia Wesleyan College (B.A., 2003) and Old Dominion University (M.A., Elementary Education, 2012).
The profile gives Convirs-Fowler's occupation as real estate broker.
Convirs-Fowler's listed memberships and affiliations include Hillcrest Farms Homeowners Association (board member).
